units.source_text: ’幸而这官人穿的单衣和裙子都是丝绸的，行动没有窸窣声，里面不会有人注意到吧。”

en.t: Fortunately, the courtier's unlined robe and skirt were both silk, so his movements made no rustling sound, and surely no one inside would notice.

units.source_text: 薰大将想：“我本来道心日渐坚定了，只因宇治之事走错了一步，以致变成一个百苦交煎的凡夫！

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "My resolve to follow the Buddhist path had been growing firmer day by day, but because I took one wrong step in the matter at Uji, I have become an ordinary man tormented by every suffering!

units.source_text: 如果当时早早出家为僧，现已安居深山之中，不会如此心烦意乱了。”

en.t: If I had renounced the world early and become a monk then, I would now be living peacefully deep in the mountains and would not be so distracted and distressed."
He turned these thoughts over and over, his feelings in turmoil.

units.source_text: 又想：“我为什么年来一直渴望看到大公主呢？

en.t: Then he thought, "Why have I longed all these years to see the elder princess?

units.source_text: 如今见了，反而增加痛苦。

en.t: Now that I have seen her, it has only increased my suffering.
This is truly something beyond all remedy."
